_comment_model: Use a public model alias, never a pinned dated/tagged ID (e.g. NOT 'claude-opus-4-8-20260115[1m]'). See rules/orchestration.md for the alias routing table.
_comment_enabledMcpjsonServers: Example only, not live. Uncomment and rename to 'enabledMcpjsonServers' (an array of server names from your .mcp.json) once you've run 'claude mcp add' for the servers you want auto-enabled, e.g. ["context7", "exa"].

hooks._comment: macOS-only (osascript). Cross-platform alternatives: notify-send (Linux) or terminal-notifier (macOS CLI wrapper) — swap the command for your OS.
hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code needs your attention" with title "Claude Code"'

statusLine._comment: Reads the adopter's own local ~/.claude.json (or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json) at runtime for account email, model, git branch, context window, and rate-limit usage. Requires jq.
statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cfg="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:+$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json}"; cfg="${cfg:-$HOME/.claude.json}"; email=$(jq -r '.oauthAccount.emailAddress // empty' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "?"'); branch=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.git.branch // empty'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); in_tok=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // empty'); out_tok=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_output_tokens // empty'); five=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); bar=''; if [ -n "$used" ]; then u=$(printf '%.0f' "$used"); filled=$((u / 10)); empty=$((10 - filled)); bar='['; i=0; while [ $i -lt $filled ]; do bar="${bar}█"; i=$((i+1)); done; i=0; while [ $i -lt $empty ]; do bar="${bar}░"; i=$((i+1)); done; bar="${bar}] ${u}%"; fi; tok=''; if [ -n "$in_tok" ]; then in_k=$((in_tok / 1000)); out_k=$((out_tok / 1000)); tok="${in_k}K in / ${out_k}K out"; fi; out="${email:+$email | }$model"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out | $branch"; [ -n "$bar" ] && out="$out | $bar"; [ -n "$tok" ] && out="$out | $tok"; [ -n "$five" ] && out="$out | 5h: $(printf '%.0f' "$five")%"; [ -n "$week" ] && out="$out | 7d: $(printf '%.0f' "$week")%"; echo "$out"
